blurb: Colorado Ballet Society provides world-class pre-professional training in ballet and dance in a safe, state-of-the-art facility. They offer a wide array of dance styles across all levels and divisions, including acrobatic dance, tap, jazz, contemporary, and ballet. The studio hosts workshops, summer classes, and performance opportunities for students.
